features: Fixed an issue where missing table columns for locations prevented options from loading on fresh installs
Fixed backend fatal errors that caused 'Network issue' when saving properties and CORS issues during deletion.
Implemented automatic bidirectional auto-cancellation logic: regardless of entry order, superseded properties automatically switch to CANCELLED state.
Fixed table creation for property states and settings on strict MySQL environments.
Added support for Notification Bell and Changelog.
Fixed ETRACS property table local synchronization to show correct properties.
Fixed Local Property states so that they accurately reflect CURRENT and CANCELLED pills based on their superseded status.
Support for creating, reading, updating and deleting local properties.
